Sika Sarnafil PVC and TPO Membrane Systems in Local Specifications

Sika Sarnafil manufactures reinforced PVC and TPO single-ply membrane systems that we reference when a commercial roof specification around Winston-Salem calls for its products. The Sarnafil name carries a long history specifically in PVC membrane, and we treat that product line as a serious option where chemical or grease exposure conditions make PVC the appropriate membrane chemistry.

PVC heritage and where it matters locally

Sika Sarnafil's PVC membrane line is relevant on buildings with grease, chemical, or exhaust exposure conditions, including food processing operations in Davidson County industrial parks and healthcare or laboratory buildings connected to the area's medical and research institutions, where standard TPO or EPDM may not hold up as well against sustained exposure. We specify Sarnafil PVC where that exposure profile justifies the product, based on what we document during the roof walk rather than a general preference for the brand.

The company's TPO membrane line serves buildings where reflectivity, cost, or general single-ply performance is the priority rather than specific chemical resistance, and we select between the two product families based on the building's actual roof conditions.

Specification and hot-air welding detail

Sarnafil membrane specifications name membrane thickness, reinforcement, and attachment method, along with the specific insulation and flashing accessories the manufacturer's technical literature approves for its systems. Hot-air welding technique for Sarnafil PVC requires settings specific to that membrane's chemistry, and we do not treat welding procedure as interchangeable across different manufacturers' PVC or TPO products without adjustment.

Seam probing after welding is standard practice on every Sarnafil installation, checked against the manufacturer's own quality guidance rather than a generic industry assumption about what an acceptable weld looks like.

Warranty and program documentation

Sika Sarnafil's warranty programs require installation meeting the manufacturer's program standards, and we document installed system components as part of project closeout without claiming a specific certification level unless it can be factually supported. We recommend owners verify warranty terms and any program standing directly with Sika rather than relying solely on contractor representation, since program requirements and warranty scope can change between literature updates.

Warranty length and coverage depend on the specific membrane, thickness, and program tier selected, and those details should be confirmed in writing for each project before warranty terms are used to compare competing bids.

  • Exposure conditions documented during the roof walk before recommending Sarnafil PVC over other membrane options.
  • Weld settings adjusted specifically for Sarnafil membrane chemistry, not reused from other manufacturers' products.
  • Seam probing conducted across the full field per manufacturer quality guidance.
  • Insulation and flashing accessories confirmed as manufacturer-approved for the specific system.
  • Warranty program terms verified directly with the manufacturer in writing.

Field conditions affecting installation

Piedmont humidity affects Sarnafil membrane welding the same way it does any hot-air welded system, requiring attention to dew point during summer installation. Wind uplift performance published in Sarnafil's technical literature needs matching against each building's specific exposure category and parapet condition, since a published rating from a data sheet does not automatically transfer to every roof shape and height.

For chemical or grease exposure environments specifically, we document the observed conditions in the specification file, since warranty terms in these environments often include exclusions or requirements tied to exposure type and concentration.

Documentation for owners and procurement teams

We provide owners with the specific Sarnafil product data sheets referenced in a specification, allowing independent verification against the manufacturer's published documentation rather than a contractor summary. For buildings with known chemical exposure, we recommend owners maintain records of any process or equipment changes that could increase exposure beyond what the original specification accounted for.

Any field deviation from standard Sarnafil detailing gets documented, and where warranty implications exist, we raise the issue with the manufacturer's representative rather than resolving it informally on site.

Comparing Sarnafil against a general-purpose TPO bid

Owners weighing a Sarnafil PVC proposal against a lower-priced standard TPO bid for a building with real grease or chemical exposure should look past the initial number and ask what the exposure conditions would do to a standard membrane over the roof's expected service life. A lower upfront price on a membrane not suited to the exposure profile can mean an earlier failure and a second capital outlay sooner than the original replacement schedule would have required.

We document exposure conditions clearly enough that an owner can make that comparison with real information rather than guessing at how a cheaper membrane might hold up under kitchen or process exhaust it was not designed to resist.

Questions about Sika Sarnafil membrane systems

What is Sika Sarnafil known for in commercial roofing?

Sarnafil carries a long-standing product line in reinforced PVC membrane, along with TPO options for buildings where chemical resistance is not the primary concern.

When does PVC from Sarnafil make more sense than TPO?

Grease, chemical, or exhaust exposure conditions are where PVC's chemistry generally holds up better than standard TPO over time.

Does a Sarnafil specification guarantee a specific warranty term?

No. Warranty length and scope depend on the specific membrane, thickness, and program tier, which should be confirmed directly with the manufacturer.

Is Sarnafil welding the same process as other manufacturers' PVC?

The general hot-air welding process is similar, but settings need adjustment for Sarnafil's specific membrane chemistry rather than reused generic settings.

Do you hold a specific certification level with Sika Sarnafil?

We work from the manufacturer's current technical documentation for each project and recommend owners confirm any specific program standing directly with the manufacturer.
